topic: Catch the Dancing Star (Taara nacha aasmaan me)
title_en: Where did the dancing star go?
description: Join Chintu elephant and Mithu parrot on a fun quest to find the dancing star in the night sky! A delightful interactive rhyme for toddlers.
learning: Identifying celestial objects and developing visual tracking skills.

scenes.text: अरे! ये चमकता सितारा कहाँ छुप गया?!
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up 3D render of Chintu the orange baby elephant looking surprised with big sparkly eyes at a dark blue night sky, 9:16 vertical orientation.

scenes.text: Look! Is it hiding behind the fluffy cloud?
scenes.image_prompt: Mithu the green parrot with a red cap pointing his wing towards a giant glowing white cloud in the night sky, high contrast, 3D CGI.

scenes.text: Tap tap tap! Let’s find the star!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu tapping his small foot on a floating moon platform, magical sparkles emitting from the floor, vibrant night colors, 3D render.

scenes.text: Mithu, jaldi dekho, kya wo wahan hai?
scenes.image_prompt: Mithu flying in a circle, looking excited, vibrant yellow tummy clearly visible, dark starry background, 3D animation style.

scenes.text: Boing boing hop! Catch the twinkling light!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu jumping joyfully in the air with his blue scarf fluttering, trying to reach a tiny winking golden star in the distance.
The dancing star bursts into a bright golden glow in front of Chintu and Mithu, both characters laughing with open mouths.

scenes.text: Yay! Hamara pyara dancing star mil gaya!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu and Mithu dancing together in a circle, surrounded by shimmering magical stardust and colorful nebulae, pure joy expression.

scenes.text: Ruko! Phir se dekho, kya wo phir chup gaya?
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu looking directly at the camera with a confused but funny expression, one finger on his chin, background fading into the opening night scene.
